detail.longDescription: Google's MCP Toolbox for Databases got a critical CVE today for a fix it shipped in June, and that fix is off by default. CVE-2026-93328 (CVSS 9.3) is path traversal in the cloud-storage source. 1.5.0 added allowedBuckets and allowedLocalRoots, but omit them and every bucket and absolute path the process can reach is still allowed. Set both, and run it as a user with only the file access it needs. https:// github.com/advisories/GHSA-2gc 9-c85v-5vwr # Cybersecurity # MCP # AIAgents
